svg.title: OSS Singularity — Many minds. One open horizon.
svg.desc: Vector reconstruction of the generated OSS Singularity banner. All text is converted to vector outlines so the typography does not require installed fonts. The supplied original OSS Singularity brand mark is preserved as vector geometry. No raster images or external resources. This is a reconstruction, not the original source of the generated PNG.

path.aria-label: An open home for every entity.
